items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: I told the Reverend I wanted to organize a big band... the Reverend and I put together the date for that, and we paid for the date to record the band.

ctx.x: So in this period, you were finished with the group of Phil Porter, you were doing things here and there, and then you started with Gensel in that period?

Yeah. Well, I told the Reverend I wanted to organize a big band to play for the church, so that, you know, it would draw some people over there. I knew that would do it, especially if it's a swinging band.
Had he been transferred to St. Peter's by this time?
